story_overview: A soft five-scene bedtime story for young children about a small rounded golden star with a smiling face. The star wakes in a plush-cloud night sky, catches the eye of a pajama-wearing child in a cozy bedroom, floats above simple dreamlike hills and homes, sparkles like a diamond, and smiles goodnight with the child under many gentle stars. Keep every scene simple, readable, warm, and safe for children. Use pastel blues, creamy whites, warm golds, soft glowing edges, classic storybook shapes, and no text. The first four scenes map exactly to the four lullaby lines and carry subtitle_text for those lines. The fifth scene is a wordless visual goodnight close with no dialogue, no sung lyric, and no subtitle.

The star has a sweet smiling face, soft glowing edges, and tiny gentle sparkles. It wakes up with a tiny bounce and twinkles slowly like a music box note. Simple readable shapes for young children, pastel blue and warm gold palette, magical soft lighting, calm camera, no text, no scary elements. This scene follows the first sung line, "Twinkle, twinkle, little star," with gentle nursery-rhyme timing and no generated text or letters.
